meta.title: Link — Short links, free forever
meta.description: Custom aliases, real analytics, QR codes, passwords and a public API. The Bitly alternative that costs zero.

hero.sub: Everything Bitly charges $35 a month for — custom aliases, click analytics, QR codes, expiring links and a real API — rebuilt, open sourced and set free. Already live.

f1.d: Pick your own slug: zs.ai/launch reads better than seven random characters. Brand it, remember it, share it.

f2.d: Clicks by day, referrer, country, device, browser and OS. Cookie-less, fingerprint-less, honest.

f3.d: Every link gets an instant QR in SVG or PNG. Print it, project it, ship it.

f4.d: Lock a link with a password. Only the people you choose get through.

f5.d: Set an expiry date or a maximum click count. The link retires itself.

f6.d: Tag links by campaign, client or channel. Find anything in seconds.

f7.d: Build campaign URLs without a spreadsheet. Source, medium, campaign — done.

f8.d: Create and measure links from your code with a simple REST API and personal keys.

f9.d: Everything is yours. Export it, back it up, take it home. No hostages.

compare.note: Bitly Core costs $35 a month — $420 a year, every year. A 10-person team on per-seat pricing easily crosses $4,200 a year. Link costs $0. Forever.

f1.a: Yes. The code is open source and self-hosting costs nothing. If we host it for you, you pay only the cloud it consumes — at cost, no margin. Software was never the expensive part; the business model was.

f2.q: Can I migrate my links from Bitly?
f2.a: Yes. Export your links from Bitly as CSV and import them: destinations, aliases and tags come over. Point your old short domain to us and existing links keep working.

f3.q: What happens if Zerosoft shuts down?
f3.a: Nothing bad. The code is open source, so anyone can run it forever. You can export every link and every click at any time, and self-hosting takes one command. Your links can never be held hostage.

f4.a: That is the point. Clone the repo, run it on any server with Node and SQLite, point your short domain, done. No license key, no phone-home, no enterprise tier.

f5.a: Only if you tell them to. Links never expire on their own and never get parked behind a paywall. Expiration is a feature you control, not a threat we use.

cta.sub: Free, open, already live. Your first short link is ten seconds away.

meta.title: Track — Project management at zero

f1.d: Every action has a shortcut. Create, assign, label and close issues without touching the mouse.

f2.d: Work in focused one or two-week cycles. Scope, ship, review, repeat.

f3.d: Plan quarters, not sprints. Every project on one timeline the whole company can read.

f4.d: Changes appear everywhere in real time. Boards, lists and timelines always agree.

f5.d: New issues land in triage. Accept, merge or decline before they pollute the backlog.

f6.d: Structure work your way: teams, projects, labels and custom statuses.

f7.d: Point issues, track velocity, stop guessing deadlines.

f8.d: Close issues from commits and PRs. Branches named after tickets, automatically.

f9.d: Everything the UI does, the API does. Automate the boring parts.

compare.note: Linear Standard costs $8 per user per month. A team of 10 pays $960 a year, every year, forever. Track costs $0.

f2.d: Organize pages into a tree. Drag pages to reorder or nest them under any parent.

f3.d: Type [[ to link another page. Mentions stay connected even when titles change.

f4.d: Make a page public, share with a team, or share with a single user. You control every door.

f5.d: Invite your whole company. The price does not change because more people read docs.

f9.d: Your documents stay on your server if you want them to. No vendor lock-in, ever.

meta.title: Chat — Customer support, set free
meta.description: An Intercom-style support desk: webchat widget, shared inbox, ticket states and priority, SLAs, AI bot, office hours and CSAT. Open source. Live now.

hero.sub: An Intercom-style support desk: webchat widget, shared inbox, ticket states and priority, SLAs, an AI bot, office hours and CSAT. Open source. Live now.

f1.d: One script tag puts a fast, monochrome chat widget on any site. Identify visitors and greet them by name.

f2.d: Every conversation lands in one inbox the whole team works: assign, reply, snooze, resolve. No forwarding, no BCC.

f3.d: Open, pending, resolved — with priorities from low to urgent that bubble the important ones up. Nothing slips.

f4.d: Set first-response and resolution targets and see what is about to breach before it does. Support with a clock.

f5.d: The bot answers the repetitive questions first, from your canned responses or docs pages, and hands off to a human with the full thread.

f6.d: Show an away message with your expected response time when you're off, and measure satisfaction (1–5) when a conversation is resolved.

f7.d: Route conversations to the right teammate automatically and answer in two keystrokes with saved replies.

f8.d: Every visitor, lead and customer in one place: who they are, what they saw, what they asked.

f9.d: Support is a team sport. Open source, self-hostable, exportable — invite everyone, the price stays $0.

compare.note: Intercom starts around $29 per seat per month. A team of ten pays $3,480 a year. Chat costs $0.

f1.a: Yes. Open source and self-hostable for $0. If we host it, you pay only the cloud at cost. No per-seat fees, no per-resolution fees.

f4.a: You keep your conversations. Export everything, self-host the same code, and your support history stays yours.

meta.description: The Zerosoft REST API: links, CRM, teams and docs. Personal keys, JSON responses, zero friction.

docs.label: 0.05 — API
docs.title: The Zerosoft API.
docs.intro: All products expose the same style of API: REST, JSON and personal keys. If the dashboard can do it, your code can do it.
docs.authDesc: Every request needs an API key, sent as a Bearer token. For browser sessions the Google OAuth flow creates the session cookie.
docs.authNote: Create keys in Dashboard → Settings → API keys. A key is shown exactly once — copy it and store it like a password. Each key allows 100 requests per minute.
docs.linksDesc: Create, list, update and measure short links.
docs.authFlowDesc: Redirect the user to start the Google OAuth flow. After success they return to the app with a session cookie.
docs.linksCreateDesc: Creates a short link. slug is optional — leave it out and we generate one.
docs.linksListDesc: Your links, newest first. Paginate with page and pageSize (max 100).
docs.linksDeleteDesc: Archive or delete a link by id.
docs.linksPatchDesc: Update any writable field of a link.
docs.linksStatsDesc: Click totals and a per-day breakdown for one link.
docs.contactsListDesc: List contacts. Filters: q, page, pageSize (max 100).
docs.contactsPatchDesc: Update any property of a contact.
docs.companiesListDesc: List companies. Filters: q, page, pageSize.
docs.companiesPatchDesc: Update any property of a company.
docs.dealsCreateDesc: Create a deal in a pipeline stage.
docs.tasksListDesc: List tasks. bucket: overdue, today, upcoming, done.
docs.tasksCreateDesc: Create a task, optionally linked to a record.
docs.stagesCreateDesc: Create a stage inside a pipeline.
docs.teamsInviteDesc: Invite an email to join a team.
docs.teamsSwitchDesc: Switch active workspace. Use teamId: null for the personal workspace.
docs.docsPatchDesc: Update title, content or archive a page.
docs.paramTaskBucket: Filter bucket: overdue, today, upcoming, done.
docs.paramTeamIdSwitch: Team id or null for the personal workspace.
